name: The Holy Monk of Tang
description: The Holy Monk of the Tang Dynasty is based on the well-known Tang Monk in "Journey to the West". His Buddhist name is "Xuan Zang" and he is honored as "Master Tripitaka". In order to promote Buddhism and save all sentient beings, he and his three disciples, Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Seng, went to the West to learn Buddhist scriptures. Along the way, he is compassionate and spreads the Tao of Zen; he is willing to do charity and relieve people's worries; he is firm-willed and will not be deceived by all kinds of demons. In the end, with his persistent pursuit, he went through ninety-nine and eighty-one difficulties, obtained the true scriptures, and became an enlightened monk respected by everyone.
